Press the Attack.name: Press the Attack
Press the Attack.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} apply a {{tip|stack}} for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new champion, and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes all stacks to deal {{pp|40 + (160-40)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} '''bonus''' {{tip|adaptive damage}} and grant you 8% increased damage against champions until 5 seconds after exiting [[combat status|combat]] with them.
{{Tip data/Adaptive damage|pst2|description}}

Lethal Tempo.name: Lethal Tempo
Lethal Tempo.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} grant a {{tip|stack}} for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 6 times. Gain {{as|{{rd|6%|{{ap|6*0.8}}%}} '''bonus''' attack speed|as}} for each stack, up to {{as|{{rd|36%|{{ap|36*0.8}}%}}|as}} at maximum stacks.
At maximum stacks, basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target {{tip|on-attack}} that deals them {{rd|9 + (30-9)/17*(x-1) for 20|6 + (24-6)/17*(x-1) for 20|pp=true}} '''bonus''' {{tip|adaptive damage}} upon arrival, increased by {{rd|1%|{{fd|0.6{{recurring|6}}%}}}} per {{as|1% '''bonus''' attack speed}}.

Fleet Footwork.name: Fleet Footwork
Fleet Footwork.description:
{{Unique|Energized|Moving and basic attacking generates ''Charges'', up to 100.}}
At 100 ''Charges'', become {{tip|Energized}}, empowering your next {{tip|basic attack}} to {{tip|heal}} you for {{rd|15+(145/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|15*0.6+((145*0.6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|color=heal|pp=true}} {{as|(+ {{rd|10%|6%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{rd|5%|3%}} AP)}} and grant {{as|{{rd|20%|15%}}|ms}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. Against {{tip|minion|minions}}, the healing is 15% effective.

Conqueror.name: Conqueror
Conqueror.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage to enemy {{tip|champions}} generates {{tip|stacks}} of ''Conqueror'', lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage against champions, and stacking up to 12 times. Gain {{rd|2|1}} stacks for {{tip|basic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. Otherwise, gain 2 stacks for any damage that is neither {{tip|basic damage|basic}} nor non-{{tip|pet damage|pet}} {{tip|proc damage}}, up to once every 4 seconds per {{tip|cast instance}}.
Each stack of ''Conqueror'' grants {{adaptive|1.8 + (4-1.8)/17*(x-1)|20}}, up to {{adaptive|1.8*12 + (4*12-1.8*12)/17*(x-1)|20}} at maximum stacks, at which you also {{tip|heal}} for {{rd|8%|5%}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt against enemy champions.

Absorb Life.name: Absorb Life
Absorb Life.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Killing an enemy {{tip|heals}} you for {{pp|1; then +0.25*x for 4;then +1*x for 5; then +2*x|1 to 20 by 1|formula=1, +0.25 per level until level 5, then +1 per level until level 10, then +2 per level|color=heal}}.
parse_warnings: Unparseable pp formula '1; then +0.25*x for 4;then +1*x for 5; then +2*x'

Triumph.name: Triumph
Triumph.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion {{tip|heals}} you for {{as|{{fd|2.5}}% of your '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 5% of your '''missing''' health)}} and grants you an additional {{g|20}}, both after a 1-second delay.

Presence of Mind.name: Presence of Mind
Presence of Mind.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion restores {{as|15% of your '''maximum''' mana}} or {{as|15% of your '''maximum''' energy}} after a 1-second delay.
Damaging an enemy champion restores {{as|{{rd|6; then +0.8*x for 5; then +2*x for 5; then +3.2*x for 5; then +4*x for 2; then +8; then +4|6*0.8; then +0.8*0.8*x for 5; then +2*0.8*x for 5; then +3.2*0.8*x for 5; then +4*0.8*x for 2; then +8*0.8; then +4*0.8|pp=true}} mana}} or {{as|6 energy}} (8 second cooldown).
parse_warnings: pp formula '6; then +0.8*x for 5; then +2*x for 5; then +3.2*x for 5; then +4*x for 2; then +8; then +4' has no level range

Legend: Alacrity.name: Legend: Alacrity

Legend: Haste.name: Legend: Haste

Legend: Bloodline.name: Legend: Bloodline

Coup de Grace.name: Coup de Grace
Coup de Grace.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Deal 8% increased damage to champions below {{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}.

Cut Down.name: Cut Down
Cut Down.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Deal 8% increased damage to champions above {{as|60% '''maximum''' health}}.

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Deal 5% increased damage to champions while below {{as|60% '''maximum''' health}}. This increases further based on your {{as|'''missing''' health}}, up to 11% increased damage while below {{as|30% '''maximum''' health}}.

Electrocute.name: Electrocute
Electrocute.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Damaging {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities}}, [[Named item effect|item effects]], and [[summoner spell]]s, as well as the application of {{tip|crowd control}} and {{tip|damage over time}} effects, apply {{tip|stacks}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}}, up to one per {{tip|cast instance}} per champion. Applying 3 stacks to a target within a 3 second period causes them to be struck by lightning after a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, dealing them {{pp|60 + 10 * x|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} of either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}}. {{sbc|Variable Damage:}} This effect deals either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}} depending on the damage contribution from your {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} and {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} to the effect's damage formula.
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AD ratio}}}} → {{as|Physical damage}}
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AP ratio}}}} → {{as|Magic damage}}
If the damage contribution of {{as|{{sti|AD}}}} and {{as|{{sti|AP}}}} are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type defaults to {{as|magic damage}}.

Dark Harvest.name: Dark Harvest
Dark Harvest.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing {{tip|pet damage|pet}} or non-{{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage against enemy {{tip|champions}} below {{as|50% of their '''maximum''' health}} deals 30 {{as|(+ 11 per Soul)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} '''bonus''' {{tip|adaptive damage}} and, after a {{fd|1.75}}-second delay, reap {{as|1 Soul}}. This cannot occur again for 35 seconds, resetting to 1 second upon scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion.
While not on cooldown, also reap {{as|1 Soul}} from receiving the kill credit of a champion killed by a {{tip|minion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret}}.

Hail of Blades.name: Hail of Blades
Hail of Blades.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Starting an {{tip|attack windup}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} triggers ''Hail of Blades'', and if the windup completes, you gain 2 stacks of the effect for 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing on basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} against enemy champions until all stacks are consumed. Stacks are consumed per basic attack on-attack and you generate an additional stack of the effect each time you activate an effect that has a {{tip|basic attack reset}}, up to 2 times. While ''Hail of Blades'' is active, you gain {{as|{{rd|90%|60%}} {{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}|as}}, are allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}}, and basic attacks deal {{pp|2 + (20-2)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}.

''The triggering attack benefits from Hail of Blades.''

Cheap Shot.name: Cheap Shot

Taste of Blood.name: Taste of Blood
Taste of Blood.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Damaging an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|heal|heals}} you for {{pp|16 + (40-16)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}.
Does not trigger at full health.

Sudden Impact.name: Sudden Impact
Sudden Impact.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage to an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 4 seconds of using a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}}, or exiting from {{tip|stealth}}, deals {{as|{{pp|20 to 80}} '''bonus''' true damage}} to them.

Sixth Sense.name: Sixth Sense
Sixth Sense.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Upon moving near an un-tracked enemy {{tip|ward}}, it is automatically tracked with a [[File:Enemy Ward time indicator.png|30px|link=]] [[Ward#Ward_Timers|ward timer]].
At level 11, also {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the ward for 10 seconds upon being triggered.

Grisly Mementos.name: Grisly Mementos
Grisly Mementos.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Gain 6 [[trinket haste]] per ''Memento'' stack, up to 108 haste at maximum stacks.
Earn a ''Memento'' stack whenever scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}}, up to 18 stacks.

Deep Ward.name: Deep Ward
Deep Ward.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Stealth Ward|Stealth Wards}} and {{tip|Totem Ward|Totem Wards}} placed in the enemy jungle are considered ''Deep''. All ''Deep'' wards are granted {{as|1 '''bonus''' health}}, ''Deep'' {{tip|Stealth Ward|Stealth Wards}} last {{pp|30 to 45|type=average champion level}} seconds longer, and ''Deep'' {{tip|Totem Ward|Totem Wards}} last {{pp|45 to 150|type=average champion level}} seconds longer.
At level 9, wards placed in the river will also be considered ''Deep''.

Treasure Hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
Treasure Hunter.description:
Gain {{g|50}} (+ {{g|20}} per ''Bounty Hunter'' stack) per unique takedown, up to {{g|{{ap|(50*5)+(20*10)}}}} at 5 unique takedowns.
1st unique takedown: {{g|50}}, 2nd: {{g|{{ap|50+20}}}}, 3rd: {{g|{{ap|50+(20*2)}}}}, 4th: {{g|{{ap|50+(20*3)}}}}, 5th: {{g|{{ap|50+(20*4)}}}}.
parse_warnings: flat_gold matched again after a conflict: 450.0
flat_gold matched again after a conflict: 50.0
flat_gold matched again after a conflict: 70.0
flat_gold matched again after a conflict: 90.0
flat_gold matched again after a conflict: 110.0
flat_gold matched again after a conflict: 130.0

Relentless Hunter.name: Relentless Hunter
Relentless Hunter.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|8 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while [[combat status|out of combat]] per ''Bounty Hunter'' stack, up to {{as|40|ms}} at 5 stacks.
Earn a ''Bounty Hunter'' [[stack]] whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion, up to one per unique champion.

Ultimate Hunter.name: Ultimate Hunter
Ultimate Hunter.description:
Gain 6 (+ 5 per ''Bounty Hunter'' [[stack]]) [[ultimate haste]], up to 31 at 5 stacks.
Earn a ''Bounty Hunter'' stack whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, up to one per unique champion.

Summon Aery.name: Summon Aery
Summon Aery.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Damaging {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities}}, and [[Named item effect|item effects]] against an enemy {{tip|champion}} signal ''Aery'' to pounce at them over {{fd|0.45}} seconds, dealing {{pp|10 + (40/17)*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} {{tip|adaptive damage}}. {{tip|Healing}}, {{tip|shield|shielding}}, or {{tip|buff|buffing}} an allied champion signals ''Aery'' to leap to their side over {{fd|0.35}} seconds, {{tip|shield|shielding}} them for {{pp|20 + (100-20)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} for 2 seconds.
''Aery'' applies her effects to the affected champion upon arrival. She then lingers on the target for {{tt|2 seconds|Slightly less than this duration}} before flying back to the user, and cannot be sent out again until she returns. While on her way back, she is {{tt|initially very slow|return speed's initial value is 200 at levels 1-5, 300 at levels 6-10 and 600 at level 11+}}, but {{tt|gradually accelerates|+10 speed per 51 units she travels}}, and {{tt|can be picked up by moving near her|+2000 speed per 51 units traveled after coming within 200 units of the user}}.

Arcane Comet.name: Arcane Comet
Arcane Comet.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing {{tip|ability damage}} or {{tip|pet damage}} to an enemy {{tip|champion}} hurls an ''Arcane Comet'' at their current location that lands after {{rutngt|0.8}}, dealing {{pp|15 + (100-15)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} of either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 140 radius upon impact. This damage is increased by {{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 750|key=%|label1=units|type=distance the comet travelled|label=damage increase}}, up to a maximum of {{pp|15*2 + (200-30)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*2}}% AP)}} at maximum range. {{sbc|Variable Damage:}} This effect deals either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}} depending on the damage contribution from your {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} and {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} to the effect's damage formula.
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AD ratio}}}} → {{as|Physical damage}}
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AP ratio}}}} → {{as|Magic damage}}
If the damage contribution of {{as|{{sti|AD}}}} and {{as|{{sti|AP}}}} are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type defaults to {{as|magic damage}}.

Stormraider's Surge.name: Stormraider's Surge
Stormraider's Surge.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing {{tt|damage|post-mitigation damage}} to an enemy champion equal to {{as|25% of their '''maximum''' health}} within 3 seconds grants you {{as|{{rd|48%|36%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}} and 50% {{tip|slow resist}} for 4 seconds.

Deathfire Touch.name: Deathfire Touch
Deathfire Touch.description:
Dealing {{tip|ability damage}} or {{tip|pet damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} inflicts a burn that deals {{pp|(3/2) + ((12/2)-(3/2))/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7/2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5/2}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration. After the burn has lingered on a target for 3 seconds, its damage to them is increased{{ft|by 75%|to {{pp|(3*1.75/2) + ((12*1.75/2)-(3*1.75/2))/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7*1.75/2|round=3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*1.75/2|round=3}}% AP)}} per tick}}while it lasts.
The burn's duration is based on the form of ability damage dealt to the target and is refreshed on subsequent applications:
* {{tip|Spell damage}}: 4 seconds.
* {{tip|Area damage}}: 2 seconds.
* {{tip|Persistent damage}}: 1 second.
* {{tip|Persistent area damage}}: 1 second.
* {{tip|Pet damage}}: 1 second.

Axiom Arcanist.name: Axiom Arcanist
Axiom Arcanist.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Your ultimate has 12% increased damage (reduced to 8% for [[area of effect]] abilities), {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{tip|shield|shielding}}.
Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces your ultimate ability's '''current''' cooldown by 7%.

Manaflow Band.name: Manaflow Band
Manaflow Band.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} {{tt|Affecting|See notes}} an enemy {{tip|champion}} with an [[champion ability|ability]] permanently increases your {{sti|mana|{{as|'''maximum''' mana by 25}}}}, up to {{as|250 mana}}. {{as|Mana}} gained from this effect preserves your {{as|'''current''' mana}}.
After reaching {{as|250 '''bonus''' mana}}, permanently restore {{as|1% of your '''missing''' mana}} every 5 seconds.

Nimbus Cloak.name: Nimbus Cloak
Nimbus Cloak.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Using a [[summoner spell]] grants {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{pp|type=summoner spell cooldown|key=%|15;35;45|0;100;250|color=ms|showtype=false|changedisplay=true}}}} {{as|(based on summoner spell cooldown)|ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} decaying over 2 seconds.

Transcendence.name: Transcendence
Transcendence.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Gain '''bonuses''' upon reaching the following levels:
* Level 5: + 5 [[ability haste]].
* Level 8: + 5 [[ability haste]].
* Level 11: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} reduces the '''current''' cooldowns of your basic [[champion ability|abilities]] by 20%.

Celerity.name: Celerity
Celerity.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} All [[movement speed]] '''bonuses''' increase in effectiveness by 7%.
Additionally, you gain {{sti|{{as|1% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.

Absolute Focus.name: Absolute Focus
Absolute Focus.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Gain {{adaptive|3 + (30-3)/17*(x-1)|20}} while above {{as|70% of your '''maximum''' health}}.
{{sbc|Adaptive:}} Grants bonuses based on which stat you already have the most bonuses for. ''Defaults to the first listed.''

Scorch.name: Scorch
Scorch.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing {{tip|ability damage}} to an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}} sets them on fire, dealing them {{as|{{pp|20 + (40-20)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}}|magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} after 1 second.

Waterwalking.name: Waterwalking
Waterwalking.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} While in the [[Summoner's Rift|river]], you gain {{sti|{{as|10|ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{adaptive|13 + (30-13)/17*(x-1)|20}}.
{{sbc|Adaptive:}} Grants bonuses based on which stat you already have the most bonuses for. ''Defaults to the first listed.''

Gathering Storm.name: Gathering Storm
Gathering Storm.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Gain increasing {{tip|adaptive Force}} every 10 minutes that grants a total of {{as|{{pp|(4*0.6)*x*(x-1);∞|0 to 70 for 8;∞|type=minutes|formula=2.4 * m * (m-1), where m = 1 + (1 per 10 minutes of game time)|changedisplay=true}} '''bonus''' Attack Damage}} or {{as|{{pp|4*x*(x-1);∞|0 to 70 for 8;∞|type=minutes|formula=4 * m * (m-1), where m = 1 + (1 per 10 minutes of game time)|changedisplay=true}} Ability Power}}.
{{sbc|Adaptive:}} Grants bonuses based on which stat you already have the most bonuses for. ''Defaults to the first listed.''
parse_warnings: Unsupported pp range spec '0 to 70 for 8;∞'
Unsupported pp range spec '0 to 70 for 8;∞'

Grasp of the Undying.name: Grasp of the Undying
Grasp of the Undying.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Entering [[Combat status|combat]] generates 1 [[stack]] every second for the next 3 seconds, refreshing the duration with each instance of combat and stacking the effect up to 4 times. At maximum stacks, your next [[basic attack]] {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds against an enemy {{tip|champion}} consumes all stacks to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{rd|{{fd|3.5}}%|{{fd|1.4}}%}} of your '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heal}} you for {{as|(+ {{rd|{{fd|1.3}}%|{{fd|0.52}}%}} of your '''maximum''' health)}}, and permanently grant you {{as|{{rd|5|2}} '''bonus''' health}}.

Aftershock.name: Aftershock
Aftershock.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy {{tip|champion}} grants you a static {{as|45|armor}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|45|mr}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. The '''bonus''' resistances are each capped at {{pp|80 to 150}}.
After the duration, you release a shockwave that deals {{as|{{pp|25 to 120}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 8% of your '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}} to enemy champions and {{tip|monster|monsters}} within a {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 350 radius.

Guardian.name: Guardian
Guardian.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} While within 350 units of an allied {{tip|champion}}, you raise your ''Guard''. Allied champions you affect with [[unit-targeted]] [[champion ability|abilities]] are also ''Guarded'' for 3 seconds, regardless of distance.
If you or a ''Guarded'' ally would take {{pp|50 + (165-50)/17*(x-1) for 20}} damage within {{fd|2.5}} seconds or lethal damage from an enemy champion, {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|turret}}, you both gain a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 + (150-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 20% of your AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% of your '''bonus''' health)}} for 2 seconds.

Demolish.name: Demolish
Demolish.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} against {{tip|turrets}} apply a stack of ''Demolish'', stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a turret consumes them all to deal {{as|{{rd|85|50}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{rd|28%|20%}} of your '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
''Demolish'' cannot be triggered on the same turret by any of its users more than once every 3 seconds.

Font of Life.name: Font of Life
Font of Life.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|slow|Slowing}} or {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|heals}} you and the nearest and most wounded allied champion within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 1000 units for {{rd|10 + (50-10)/17*(x-1) for 20|10*0.7 + (50*0.7-10*0.7)/17*(x-1) for 20|pp=true|type=your level|color=heal}}.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever you gain a {{tip|shield}}, your next attack against an enemy {{tip|champion}} is empowered to deal {{pp|5 + (30-5)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 15% shield amount)}} '''bonus''' {{tip|adaptive damage}} [[on-hit]]. The empowered attack lasts for up to 2 seconds after the shield expires.
{{Tip data/Adaptive damage|pst2|description}}

Conditioning.name: Conditioning
Conditioning.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} After 12 minutes, gain {{sti|armor|{{as|8 '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|8 '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and your {{as|'''total''' armor}} and {{as|'''total''' magic resistance}} are increased by 3%.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} After taking damage from an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{sti|health regeneration|link=true|regenerate}} {{as|4% of your '''missing''' health}} over 10 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage.

Bone Plating.name: Bone Plating
Bone Plating.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} After taking damage from an enemy {{tip|champion}}, activate ''Bone Plating'' for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While active, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from the enemy champion that triggered this effect deal {{pp|30 + (60-30)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} less damage (including {{tip|true damage}}).

Overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
Overgrowth.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Every 8 {{tip|monster|monsters}} or enemy {{tip|minion|minions}} that die near you permanently generates a [[stack]]. Each stack grants {{as|3 '''bonus''' health}}. This effect can stack indefinitely.
After reaching 15 stacks (120 monsters or minions), your {{as|'''base'''|health}} and {{as|'''bonus''' health}} are permanently increased by {{fd|3.5}}%.

Revitalize.name: Revitalize
Revitalize.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Grants {{sti|heal and shield power|5% [[Heal and shield power]]}}.
Outgoing {{tip|heal|healing}} and outgoing {{tip|shield|shielding}} are increased by 10% on targets {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}.

Unflinching.name: Unflinching
Unflinching.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While afflicted with {{tip|crowd control}} sourced from enemy {{tip|champion|champions}}, gain {{as|{{#vardefineecho:armorunflinching|10}} '''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|{{#vardefineecho:mrunflinching|10}} '''bonus''' magic resistance}}, lingering for 2 seconds after the impairment ends.

Glacial Augment.name: Glacial Augment
Glacial Augment.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy {{tip|champion}} will cause 3 glacial rays to emanate from them towards you and other nearby enemy champions, creating icy zones with a 700 unit radius that last for 3 (+ 100% of the {{tt|immobilizing effect's duration|Duration after being modified by tenacity}}) seconds.
Enemies within the icy zones, which have a width of 80 units, are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% {{as|(+ 7% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 9% per 10% heal and shield power)}} and have their damage reduced by 15% against your allies, excluding yourself.

Unsealed Spellbook.name: Unsealed Spellbook
Unsealed Spellbook.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} While not channeling {{si|Teleport}} and being [[combat status|out-of-combat]] for 5 seconds, you can swap one of your equipped [[summoner spell]]s to a new, single use summoner spell. You cannot select a summoner spell you have already equipped.
Your first swap becomes available at {{sbc|{{MinuteDisplay|{{#var:initialcd}}}}}}. Swaps have an initial cooldown of {{#var:cdb}} seconds; selecting a unique summoner spell reduces the swap cooldown by {{#var:cdm}} seconds. You must swap to 3 different summoner spells before returning to one you have already used.

First Strike.name: First Strike
First Strike.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Initiating [[combat]] with an enemy {{tip|champion}} within the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds of champion combat grants {{g|10}} and ''First Strike'' for 3 seconds, causing all of your {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt against champions to deal {{as|7% '''bonus''' true damage}}. Afterwards, you are granted {{g|gold}} equal to {{rd|50%|35%}} of all '''bonus''' damage dealt within the duration.
''First Strike'' will be placed on full cooldown without activating its effects after being struck by an enemy champion before you strike them.

Hextech Flashtraption.name: Hextech Flashtraption
Hextech Flashtraption.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} While {{si|Flash}} has a remaining cooldown greater than 2 seconds, it is replaced by ''{{si|Hexflash}}''.
{{sbc|Active:}} You begin {{tip|channel|charging}} for up to 2 seconds, setting your {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} to a {{as|static 0|ms}}, and increasing ''Hexflash's'' range over the duration. After at least 1 second, you can reactivate the spell, which is automatically done so when the charge completes without reactivation. Releasing the charge earlier than 1 second or entering combat with an enemy {{tip|champion}} will put ''Hexflash'' on {{sti|cooldown}} for 10 seconds.

Magical Footwear.name: Magical Footwear
Magical Footwear.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} After 12 minutes (reduced by 45 seconds whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion), you gain {{ii|Slightly Magical Boots}} for {{g|free}}. ''Slightly Magical Boots'' are identical to {{ii|Boots}} and can be upgraded as if it were the item. If the inventory is full while receiving the boots, they will appear as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.
Additionally, your boots grant an additional {{sti|{{as|10 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.

Cash Back.name: Cash Back
Cash Back.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Upon purchasing a [[Legendary item]], you are automatically refunded {{fd|7.5}}% of its total {{g|gold}} cost.
''Selling or undoing the item's purchase will cancel the refund, reducing your current {{g|gold}} equal to the refunded amount.''

Triple Tonic.name: Triple Tonic

Time Warp Tonic.name: Time Warp Tonic
Time Warp Tonic.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Upon consuming a potion ({{ii|Health Potion|icononly=true}}{{ii|Refillable Potion|icononly=true}}), you additionally {{tip|heal}} equal to 40% of its '''total''' health restoration.
If a health potion is consumed while one is already active, this effect will trigger on the activation of the next potion once the restoration of the current one ends.

Biscuit Delivery.name: Biscuit Delivery
Biscuit Delivery.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Receive a {{ii|Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will}} at {{sbc|2:00}}, {{sbc|4:00}}, and {{sbc|6:00}}. If the inventory is full while receiving a biscuit, the biscuit(s) will appear as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.
Consuming a ''Biscuit'' will permanently increase your {{as|{{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} by {{as|30|health}}, in addition to its effects. You will also gain the increased health if you sell the biscuit for {{g|5}}.

Cosmic Insight.name: Cosmic Insight
Cosmic Insight.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Gain 18 [[ability haste#Increasing summoner spell haste|summoner spell haste]] and 10 [[ability haste#Increasing item haste|item haste]].

Approach Velocity.name: Approach Velocity
Approach Velocity.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|{{fd|7.5}}% '''bonus total''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} that are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|slow|slowed}} within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1000 range.
This bonus is doubled to {{as|15%|ms}} and does not have a range cap nor require {{tip|sight|vision}} toward enemy champions whose movement you impaired when they were {{tip|sight|visible}}.{{bug|2}}

Jack Of All Trades.name: Jack Of All Trades
Jack Of All Trades.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Earn 1 ''Jack'' stack for each unique [[champion statistic|stat type]] currently gained from [[item]]s.
{{sbc|Jack:}} For each ''Jack'' stack, gain {{as|1 ability haste}}. At 5 ''Jack'' stacks, gain {{adaptive|8}}. At 10 ''Jack'' stacks, gain an additional {{adaptive|12}}, for a total of {{adaptive|20}} at 10 ''Jack'' stacks.
